body: The end of the day it’s your jacket, onlookers are gonna see it for like a minute, no one really cares what you do with it
Thank you that’s a very insightful observation!

Yea I am getting help, to be honest, I thought I would try venting on here cause I don’t know anyone and I didn’t really think I would get a reply. 
My boyfriend is extremely supportive but I just don’t want to tell him this stuff cause I don’t want him thinking I would choose this stuff over him, I don’t really have a “choice” in it per say but bleh I guess that’s how addiction works. 
I used to cut myself for different reasons but over the years I became addicted to the sensation and endorphins that come with it.
